description: Characterization cases for the container visit schedule. The oracle is Klacks.Ui ContainerTemplateRouteService.applyOptimizedRoute (with ContainerTemplateItemManipulationService.applyOptimizedRoute) and convertAbsencesToTimeBlocks; Klacks.Api ContainerVisitScheduler, ContainerAbsenceTimeBlocks and ContainerTemplateItemOrder must reproduce every expected value. Both sides pin the SHA-256 of this file (CRLF normalized to LF).

cases.name: two-visits-without-base-steps
cases.note: No base step in the route: the first visit uses travelTimeFromStartBase, the return leg goes to the last visit.

cases.name: leading-start-base-step-is-skipped-but-advances-the-index
cases.note: Step 0 is the start base (all-zero shiftId): it matches no item, so the first visit takes the travel of step 0, not travelTimeFromStartBase.

cases.name: minimum-travel-time-per-transport-mode
cases.note: Positive travel below the minimum is lifted to 5 (car), 3 (bicycle), 1 (foot); a missing mode counts as car.

cases.name: zero-and-sub-second-travel-stay-zero
cases.note: Travel of 00:00:00 and of a fraction of a second parses to zero minutes, so no minimum travel time is applied.

cases.name: seconds-truncated-and-ceiled-to-minutes
cases.note: Fractional seconds are cut off by parseInt (00:07:00.5 is 7 min); whole seconds round the minute up (00:07:30 is 8 min).

cases.name: days-prefix-is-read-as-hours
cases.note: A travel time of a day or more ('1.02:00:00') is read as hours=1 by parseInt, a quirk ported as-is.

cases.name: work-time-rounds-half-up
cases.note: Work time hours x 60 is rounded half up like Math.round (0.125 h = 8 min, 0.875 h = 53 min, 1.0083 h = 60 min).

cases.name: briefing-seconds-are-ignored
cases.note: Briefing and debriefing are read as hours and minutes only; 00:05:59 counts as 5 minutes.

cases.name: fixed-break-pushes-overlapping-visit-and-splits-travel
cases.note: A fixed 12:00-12:30 break overlaps the second visit: it starts at the break end, the previous visit's travelTimeAfter becomes the gap until the break and the travel before is what remains after it.

cases.name: break-in-a-gap-still-splits-travel
cases.note: The break lies between two visits without overlapping either; the travel is still split around it.

cases.name: break-before-first-visit-never-splits
cases.note: A break overlapping the first visit moves it, but with no previous visit the travel before is not split.

cases.name: two-breaks-single-forward-pass
cases.note: Breaks are checked once in start order; a visit pushed past the first break is pushed again by an overlapping later one, never re-checked against an earlier one.

cases.name: break-across-midnight-and-equal-bounds-full-day
cases.note: A 23:00-01:00 break ends at 25:00; a break with equal bounds (13:00-13:00) becomes a full 24-hour block that throws an overlapping visit to the next day.

cases.name: return-leg-only-with-distance
cases.note: No return leg when distanceToEndBaseKm is 0: the last visit keeps its stored travelTimeAfter.

cases.name: return-leg-zero-time-with-distance
cases.note: A return leg of 00:00:00 with a positive distance still overwrites the last visit's travelTimeAfter with 00:00; middle visits keep their stored value.

cases.name: return-leg-uses-last-visit-mode
cases.note: The return travel uses the minimum of the last visit's own transport mode (foot = 1 minute).

cases.name: midnight-wrap
cases.note: Visits running past midnight wrap their clock times (24:10 is written as 00:10:00).

cases.name: unmatched-step-mid-route-and-unrouted-item
cases.note: A route step without an item still advances the index (the next visit takes its travel); an item missing from the route is dropped.

cases.name: item-without-loaded-shift-is-dropped
cases.note: An item whose shift is not loaded is skipped: it is dropped and does not advance the running clock.

cases.name: duplicate-shift-id-last-item-wins
cases.note: Two items with the same shiftId collapse to the last one.

cases.name: interleave-breaks-by-start
cases.note: Breaks are inserted before the first visit that starts later; a movable break (no fixed start) counts as 00:00 and goes first; equal starts keep their order; non-TimeRange visits are placed by their startItem, not by the computed time.

cases.name: time-blocks-from-absences
cases.note: Absence to time block conversion: fixed blocks keep their times, movable ones default to 00:00-00:30, durations wrap past midnight and are at least 1 minute.

cases.name: empty-route-keeps-only-breaks
cases.note: The optimizer found no route: the Ui keeps only the breaks (every visit is dropped).

cases.name: empty-route-without-breaks-writes-nothing
cases.note: The optimizer found no route and there is no break: the Ui leaves the items untouched (no result).
